description: Original OL Shanhe map UI: screenshot-confirmed native atlas sprites, all fourteen Season 5 backgrounds and source-positioned landmarks copied byte-for-byte, plus the source-bound chapter progress background, fill and separators extracted losslessly from the frozen atlas. Sprite sourceSize padding is retained; no images are resized.

chapterProgressRenderer.renderer: zyt.InitUI / UpdateChapterDay / UpdateChapterDayNoAnim / SetDaySplit / ProgressBarAniComplete; H6t.createtopView
chapterProgressRenderer.placement: H6t creates zyt at x=(gameWidth-width)>>1, y=0, zOrder=2. Both bar sprites are placed at (0,50); rogue_boss_icon is placed at (207,17).
chapterProgressRenderer.fill: progress=min(1, ChapterData.day/(ChapterCS.ChapterDay + HuiYanShiZhu + HuiYanShiZhu2)); daybar.width=barbg.width*progress. The animated path tweens width over 1000ms using sineOut; no rule changes are imported.
chapterProgressRenderer.separators: SetDaySplit(t) positions rogue_day_split at x=(barbg.width/t)*(index+1), y=53 for index=0..t-1: six slots have five internal lines and a right-boundary line.
chapterProgressRenderer.bossState: bossicontex.Gray=!(ChapterData.day>=ChapterCS.AppTime). Ready displays the original gold shield; locked uses the client's Gray filter rather than a separate grey asset or lower opacity. rogue_boss_bg is not used by zyt and is not imported for this widget.
chapterProgressRenderer.currentProgressEffect: res/assets/animate/roguelike/FX_jindutiao.sk follows the fill edge, with scaleX=progress; at full progress the renderer moves it to the bar centre and plays animation 1. This animation is not present in the inspected local cache, so no static current-glow frame is claimed.
chapterProgressRenderer.readyBossEffect: res/assets/animate/roguelike/gouge_jindutiao.sk is centred on the boss shield and visible only when ready. The frozen version index lists its sk/png, but neither file is present in the inspected local cache; neither is imported.
chapterProgressRenderer.calendarEvidence: ChapterCS is selected by season and CurrentChapterNumber, not by map region. Source month=(ChapterCS.Month+day)%12||12 and year=ChapterCS.Year+ceil((ChapterCS.Month+day)/12)-1; the source year label is 公元{0}年. Frozen Season 5 chapter rows use (Year,Month,ChapterDay,AppTime)=(190,1,4,4),(190,7,6,6),(191,1,7,7). These source calendar and threshold values are evidence only and are not substituted for the local six-step chapter rules.
chapterProgressRenderer.sourceScaleEvidence: The new entries retain the existing sourceScale=2 presentation convention, corresponding to a 258x19 bar and 2x13 divider at half-size. This is inferred from the 348-wide widget and the shield's x=207 geometry; the atlas meta.scale is 1 and an explicit client-wide downscale has not been proven. PNG pixel dimensions below are exact and unchanged.
